title: DOA
text: DOA. I am disappointed but not surprised. More often than not, things don't work right out of the package. That is the case for this one; the light came on and nothing. I wouldn't want a replacement because there is no guarantee that the next one will last past the Amazons return date. On top of that, I believe when you buy something you shouldn't have to pay for a warranty of any kind. What does that say about the product if you do?
